title: Shh! The First Door
objectives_ko: 두 글자 sh 가 한 소리 /ʃ/ 를 낸다는 것을 알고 말한다
sh 단어 6개(ship shop shell shed fish dish)를 소리를 이어 읽고 그림과 잇고 쓴다
사이트워드 she, he를 보고 읽고, 배운 단어로 된 문장 4개를 읽는다

workbook.title: C. Read and circle.  D. Trace the sentence.

sentences.text: The fish is in the dish.
He can see a big ship.

story.title: Shh! The First Door

panels.desc: Deep in the Pair Forest, the mossy path ends at the big round wooden door in the giant tree trunk. Carved on the door are the two letters s and h side by side — these two letters are the ONLY text allowed in the picture. The door is shut tight. Pip stands in front of it with its beak open, saying the two letters one at a time and looking puzzled; Pim and Pam perch together on the iron ring handle; Bun pushes the door with both paws but it will not move; Hedgie looks around. Hidden in the picture: a little wooden garden shed among the trees, a pink scallop shell on the path, a striped fish jumping in a stream. Grumble does NOT appear.
panels.ko: s 와 h 가 새겨진 문이 꼭 닫혀 있어요. 핍은 "스… 흐…" 하고 따로따로 말해요. 핌과 팜이 "함께!"

panels.desc: Pim and Pam puff out their tiny chests and say the sound together with all their might, but only a tiny puff of air comes out and the big door just rattles. High above on a leafy branch, Grumble the old raccoon in his striped nightcap has popped his head out of his treetop bed, cross and sleepy, one paw pressed to his mouth, saying Shh! loudly down at them — a big swirling gust of wind rushes down from him, and the round door bursts open with sparkles. Bun's floppy ear and Hedgie's spikes blow back; Pip tumbles in the air. Hidden in the picture: the garden shed, a white dish on a stump, the striped fish in the stream.
panels.ko: 핌과 팜의 소리는 너무 작아 문이 덜컹거리기만 해요. 그때 나무 위 그럼블이 "쉬잇!" — 커다란 /ʃ/ 바람에 문이 펑 열려요!

panels.desc: Behind the open door is a sunny glade with a little stream. Beside the stream stands a tiny shop made from a giant pink seashell, its shelves full of shells, little white dishes and a toy wooden sailing ship. Beads holds up a string with three beads and clicks them; Hedgie points at the shell shop; Bun crouches by the stream where a striped fish leaps; Pip sits on the toy ship. Hidden in the picture: the toy ship, the shell shop, a shell, a white dish, the fish.
panels.ko: 문 너머엔 조개껍데기로 만든 작은 가게! 장난감 배, 접시, 시냇물의 물고기. 비즈가 sh-i-p 를 꿰어요.

ask.en: What is the shop made of?

panels.desc: Everyone looks up at Grumble on his branch. Grumble blinks in surprise with a paw over his mouth and his nightcap crooked, lantern swinging; Pim and Pam have flown up and sit together on the tip of his nightcap; Bun waves up at him with both arms; Hedgie claps; Pip, on the ground, tries the sound again with its eyes squeezed shut and two little puffs of air coming out separately. Hidden in the picture: the garden shed below the tree, the toy ship in Hedgie's arms.

lines.text: He did it! He can shh!

panels.ko: 모두 그럼블을 올려다봐요. 그럼블의 "쉿!"이 바로 sh 소리였어요! 그럼블은 깜짝 놀라요. 핍은 또 "스… 흐…"

story.synopsis_ko: s 와 h 가 새겨진 첫 번째 문이 꼭 닫혀 있어요. 핍은 "스… 흐…" 따로따로, 핌과 팜의 소리는 너무 작아요. 그때 나무 위 그럼블이 "쉿!!" — 그 소리가 바로 sh! 문이 열리고 조개껍데기 가게가 나타나요.
story.so_far_ko: 친구들이 짝꿍 숲에 들어와 쌍둥이 파랑새 핌과 팜을 만났어요. 나무 위에서 그럼블의 등불이 보였어요.
story.goal_ko: 두 글자가 한 소리를 내는 sh 를 말해 첫 번째 문을 열어요.

Camera still. Playful, child-friendly. No text.

Camera still. Funny, child-friendly. No text.
